payload.summary: Where the RAG improvement programme board lives, and to check it before starting RAG-surface work
payload.detail: The RAG improvement programme board lives at docs/rag-improvement/README.md (design), HANDOVER.md (packet status table + prompts) and COORDINATION.md (coordinator manual). Before starting any RAG-surface item, check that status table AND the open PR list (#292); packets S1-S3, G1, S4-S6 landed 2026-08-17/18; Track A complete.
